title: Chip Bags Are Not Filled With Air

scenes.narration: A bag of chips is mostly not chips, and the empty part is not air.
scenes.note: Lead with the grievance so the payoff can answer it.

beats.action: Bill opens a large bag; the chips inside fill a third of it
the empty volume shades in and labels itself
an AIR label appears over the empty space and crosses out
Bill tilts the bag; the chips slide to one end and the empty space grows
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: Air is a fifth oxygen, and oxygen turns the oil in a chip rancid within days.
scenes.note: Oxygen as the villain. Molecules attacking oil is the mechanism — keep it simple and legible.

beats.action: air separates into labelled molecule groups; the oxygen fifth highlights coral
oxygen molecules drift onto a chip
the oil on the chip darkens and dulls; a RANCID mark stamps
more oxygen molecules drift down onto the chip
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: So the bag gets flushed with nitrogen, which is inert and does nothing to food, and the oxygen inside drops to almost nothing.
scenes.note: The swap, shown as a flush: nitrogen in, oxygen out. Teal displaces coral.

beats.action: a filling nozzle enters the bag
teal nitrogen floods in; coral oxygen is pushed out of the neck
nitrogen molecules bounce off the chips without reacting
the last of the coral oxygen is pushed out of the bag neck
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Split the frame. Half one is done; half two is coming.

beats.action: the frame splits; the first half fills with a FRESHNESS tick
the first half of the frame holds, ticked
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: The other half is that chips are fragile and get stacked, dropped and driven across a country, so the gas is also a pillow.
scenes.note: The transit case. Crushing is the risk — a bag surviving a stack is the proof.

beats.action: bags stack high on a pallet; a truck loads them
weight presses down; an unpressurised bag crumbles to crumbs
the gas-filled bag springs back; the second half fills with a CUSHION tick
another crate stacks on top of the pallet
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: You are buying a cushion that doubles as a preservative.
scenes.note: Bill concedes. Both halves glow. Ends without smugness.

beats.action: both halves glow together over the bag
Bill shrugs, accepts it, and eats a chip; hard cut
